**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, gateway, shipped 02:12–02:14 UTC) changed config from `gateway.pool.perRequest: false → true` and raised `gateway.timeout.upstreamMs` 2000→2500. With per-request connections against a fixed pool size of 20, the pool couldn't keep up with demand and started throwing `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14 02:14:19 UTC, about 30 seconds after the config took effect. Still ongoing as of the last log line (03:59 UTC) — the wait queue has grown from 13 to 74+, so it hasn't recovered on its own. Hits `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`. `/health` has stayed at 200 throughout.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on the gateway. Worker jobs are unaffected — no rollback needed there.
